ladder.note: 158 nights, one bet each, priced from ESPN BET's real player lines and turned into the odds Winamax is expected to pay. Figures at the closing lines (the last price before tip-off); there were no Winamax match-winner prices to replay.
ladder.verdict: At the closing lines the bets landed 80 of 158 (51%), close to the model's 53%: about break-even. At the opening lines, when the price is first posted, the same picks landed 105 of 158 (66%, +45.8 units, best climb 13): the market moves towards the model during the day. The Ladder locks three hours before the first tip-off, between the two, so the earlier you can place it at 2.00-2.10, the better.
